label: Sample follow-up timelines for the Goa demo. Set by the project team, not an official citizen's charter. Each department must replace them with its own rules before real use.
escalation_rule: Sample rule: each level has its own number of days (they are not added up). After the last level the complaint goes to the Collectorate. A department replaces this with its own rule.
after_last_level: If it is still not solved, the complaint goes to the Collectorate (District Head Office).
escalation_note: In this sample each level has its own number of days. The department sets the real days.
